text:
incident-bot: [alert] automatic pager fired for service=runtime-gpu pool=gpunode-88 region=west2 severity=high - cudaAlloc failed repeatedly, possible OOM or fragmentation. Pager: PG-4512
pd-bot: PagerDuty incident PG-4512 created and routed to @oncall_maya. Escalation policy: immediate -> 1st oncall -> 2nd if no ack in 3m.
oncall_maya: acked via PD. I'm on it, pulling logs and metrics now.
sre_oliver: hey @oncall_maya, saw brief spike earlier on the node — KV cache pressure + large batch jobs. If it's kvcache fragmentation we may need to trigger preemptive reclaim and drain.
oncall_maya: running nvml summary on gpunode-88:
```
$ ssh gpunode-88
# nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv
memory.used [MiB], memory.total [MiB], utilization.gpu [%]
15360 MiB, 16384 MiB, 12 %
```
oncall_maya: memory used near capacity but gpu util low. nvlink shows multiple allocations failing in logs: "CUBLAS_ALLOC_FAILED" and "cudaMalloc failed: out of memory".
eng_anna: any active customer jobs on that pool?
ops_jake: checking routing table and current allocations... looks like two large customer inference jobs pinned to gpunode-88 + one internal batch prewarm.
oncall_maya: initial mitigation: 1) disable new allocs to gpunode-88 (soft drain), 2) trigger fallback routing to gpunode-90 pool, 3) try remote eviction of kvcache on the node.
sre_oliver: agree. I'll run the reclaim script then coordinate drain. Command I'll run: `sudo /opt/reclaim/kvcache_evict --node gpunode-88 --threshold 0.6`
eng_anna: FYI the routing policy for ded-std has fallback to gpunode-90/gpunode-91, should be safe. Might see short 503s for in-flight requests while connections rebind.
support_liam: Customer Impact: I see ~3 customers with elevated 5xx rate from west2 for the last 30s. Opening a quick status note to customers affected.
sre_oliver: running reclaim now... log tail:```
[2026-03-17T10:02:14Z] reclaim: evicting kv entries... freed 1.2GiB
[2026-03-17T10:02:18Z] reclaim: freed 2.8GiB total.
[2026-03-17T10:02:21Z] reclaim: unable to free further pinned ranges - fragmentation suspected.
```
oncall_maya: reclaim freed some but node still failing new allocs intermittently. Proceeding to soft drain: marking scheduler weight=0 for gpunode-88.
ops_jake: scheduler updated. New allocations should route away. Watching LB connections.
eng_anna: Can we force-drop long-lived inferences to free KV cache? risk of customer errors but necessary.
sre_oliver: prefer to scale up alternate pool first. Ops: can we spin a hot spare (gpunode-99) and shift traffic?
ops_jake: launching gpunode-99 (cold -> warm). ETA ~90s.
support_liam: pushing interim message to impacted customers: "We're investigating elevated memory errors in west2; routing fallback in progress; short request failures possible. We'll update in 10m or on resolution."
pd-bot: Incident PG-4512: acknowledged by oncall_maya at 1965432105. Escalation paused.
oncall_maya: gpunode-99 live and warmed, traffic rerouting in progress. Error spikes dropping.
sre_oliver: looks like fragmentation combined with pinned allocations from a prewarm. After reroute, I suggest we reboot the node to clear driver-side fragmentation and follow up with a kernel parameter tweak for reclaim aggressiveness.
eng_anna: which kernel param? We had a recent change to nv_alloc_retry and gpu_kv_reclaim_timeout. If we lower timeout, might reduce pinned memory windows.
sre_oliver: I'll open a follow-up PR after postmortem. For now, rebooting gpunode-88 at 1965432125.
ops_jake: drain finished, resetting node. Reboot issued.
support_liam: customer 4321 reported degraded latency but no data loss. I'll attach logs to the ticket.
oncall_maya: monitoring metrics: 5xx rate now back to baseline after reroute and spare spin-up. Marking this incident as mitigated.
sre_oliver: recommend post-incident tasks: 1) postmortem, 2) evaluate prewarm policy to avoid multiple pinned large models on single pool, 3) consider auto-spin hot spare when kvcache pressure climbs over 70%.
eng_anna: adding eval to Optimize: simulate prewarm fragmentation on gpunode type and tune reclaim.
pd-bot: Incident PG-4512 status changed to mitigated at 1965432140 by oncall_maya. Please follow the runbook to file a postmortem.
oncall_maya: handing off to daytime rotation: @sre_oliver will lead postmortem and @eng_anna will take ownership of follow-up work. Thanks all, great quick coordination. :tada:
sre_oliver: acknowledged handoff, will schedule postmortem and link to this thread.
support_liam: adding customer updates and closing ticket when postmortem link available.
incident-bot: Note: automatic retention/incident log captured. Attachments: nvml-trace-1965432100.log, reclaim-output-1965432115.txt
